action_summary: Five measured §5 iterations on the own-weights, zero-model, external-store boundary: (1) one executed run in a new environment closes a residual goal class with one judgment and exact held-out replay; (2) a 75-run/163-sequence/1.84 s fit buys the same correctness as the 555-run/2,484-sequence/148.99 s fit; (3) a carried relation honestly refuses on a goal whose terms do not recompute, while N3 is falsified; (4) the same loop on a second goal fails P3 with four named false rejects; (5) a computed deictic holder-shape relation, selected by one real delayed-content judgment, fixes those witnesses, transfers across different identity names and refuses a different goal content literal. Twenty-one unique primary-source pages were opened, with key passages and hasMore limitations saved. 18 new tests pass; no capability credit or §6 completion is claimed.
